name: Jeff Staple x Nike Dunk Low Pro SB 'Black Pigeon'
story_html: Released in November 2017, the Nike Jeff Staple x Dunk Low Pro SB 'Black Pigeon' was inspired by Staples’ classic 2005 ‘Pigeon’ colorway. The shoe features a black nubuck and Stetson waterproof leather upper with a black midsole and a sienna outsole. It also comes with the original’s padded thick tongue and the iconic Pigeon logo embroidered on the heel.
